title: Counit-compatible squares preserve the unique right-adjoint comparison
statement: Let a_i:L_i ⊣ R_i and a_i′:L_i′ ⊣ R_i′ be adjunctions (i=1,2), Q:C→C′ and P:D→D′ functors, i_i:Q L_i′≅L_i P left comparison isomorphisms, and u_i(X):Q(R_i X)→R_i′(P X) maps. Suppose each u_i satisfies the displayed counit normalization L_i′(u_i) ε_i′=i_i P(ε_i). If e:L_1≅L_2 and e′:L_1′≅L_2′ satisfy i_1 P(e)=e′ i_2, then u_1 followed by the right-adjoint comparison of (a_1′ transported through e′) with a_2′ equals Q of the ordinary right-adjoint comparison followed by u_2. No naturality hypothesis on u_i is required.

source.place: Tag 07A6, lemma-adjoint, and compatibility of the Hom bijections with composition and localization.

proof.text: Apply the inverse a_2′ Hom equivalence to both maps. Replace comparisons by their counits, move e′ inverse and i_2 past the maps by naturality, and use the commutative left square and its inverse. Both sides become the image of the same ordinary counit.

theorem rightAdjointUniq_square
    {C D C' D' : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category C'] [Category D']
    {L₁ L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₁ R₂ : D ⥤ C}
    {L₁' L₂' : C' ⥤ D'} {R₁' R₂' : D' ⥤ C'}
    (a₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (a₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (a₁' : L₁' ⊣ R₁') (a₂' : L₂' ⊣ R₂')
    (Q : C ⥤ C') (P : D ⥤ D')
    (i₁ : Q ⋙ L₁' ≅ L₁ ⋙ P) (i₂ : Q ⋙ L₂' ≅ L₂ ⋙ P)
    (u₁ : ∀ X, Q.obj (R₁.obj X) ⟶ R₁'.obj (P.obj X))
    (u₂ : ∀ X, Q.obj (R₂.obj X) ⟶ R₂'.obj (P.obj X))
    (h₁ : ∀ X, L₁'.map (u₁ X) ≫ a₁'.counit.app (P.obj X) =
      i₁.hom.app (R₁.obj X) ≫ P.map (a₁.counit.app X))
    (h₂ : ∀ X, L₂'.map (u₂ X) ≫ a₂'.counit.app (P.obj X) =
      i₂.hom.app (R₂.obj X) ≫ P.map (a₂.counit.app X))
    (e : L₁ ≅ L₂) (e' : L₁' ≅ L₂')
    (he : ∀ M, i₁.hom.app M ≫ P.map (e.hom.app M) =
      e'.hom.app (Q.obj M) ≫ i₂.hom.app M) (X : D) :
    u₁ X ≫ ((a₁'.ofNatIsoLeft e').rightAdjointUniq a₂').hom.app (P.obj X) =
      Q.map (((a₁.ofNatIsoLeft e).rightAdjointUniq a₂).hom.app X) ≫ u₂ X
